objective: Test whether full native expert-pack mmap only improves when gate one-prefill is disabled, matching the earlier 5.1 tok/s diagnostic behavior while preserving strict 16GB RAM, TTFT, and correctness gates.
hypothesis: The rebuilt full-pack mmap route regressed because current source eagerly prefills 3000 gate entries, adding about 13.37GB of O_DIRECT reads and pushing cgroup file cache/reclaim pressure near the 16GB cap. Disabling only the gate prefill may preserve named cache admission and full-pack CPU fallback mmap while restoring the lower file-cache pressure seen in the 5.1 diagnostic.

method.base_env: same as rejected full-pack mmap rebuild reproduction

env_change.GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_PREFILL_LIMIT: 3000 retained but inert because /dev/null loads zero prefill entries

method.why_dev_null: GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_PREFILL_LIMIT=0 means unlimited/all entries in current source. An empty prefill profile disables prefill while keeping one_prefill_key_mode_enabled() true, preserving named cache keys.

theoretical_bound.expected_best_case: If disabling prefill reproduces the old diagnostic trajectory, token rate should be near 5.0-5.1 tok/s with TTFT well under the gate and memory_file near 12-13GB.
theoretical_bound.expected_risk: More gate cache misses may offset the removed prefill. If current source still incurs high file-cache pressure or slow fallback_t0, token rate will remain <=4.4 and the route is rejected.

acceptance.ram: memory_peak_bytes <= 16000000000 including page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, no OOM or ram_limit_killed
acceptance.correctness: France output must be semantically correct and coherent
acceptance.promotion: If it passes, record a SOTA-candidate artifact, commit/push immediately to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then run clean pushed-source reproduction before accepted SOTA promotion.

rejection.rule: If eval_tok_s <= 4.4 or any gate fails, record as rejected and keep accepted SOTA at 4.4 tok/s.
rejection.no_repeated_sampling: Do not keep sampling this route unless a new hard-bound explains the variance and predicts a stable pass.
